caseName: Gundaker Central Motors, Inc. v. Gassert
caseNameFull: Gundaker Central Motors, Inc. v. Gassert, Director, Division of Motor Vehicles of New Jersey
attorneys: Ward Kremer for appellant. Grover C. Richman, Jr., Attorney General of New Jersey, and John F. Crane, Deputy Attorney General, for Gassert, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
